name: Guillain-Barré Syndrome
definition: Acute immune-mediated polyradiculoneuropathy causing rapidly progressive weakness and reduced/absent reflexes, often after infection.

investigations.MRI: MRI may help exclude cord disease but is not diagnostic.

green: IVIG or plasma exchange when indicated
amber: Steroids are not effective as sole treatment for typical GBS; delayed referral can be dangerous.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Acute Vata-neuromuscular phenotype may be documented only after emergency modern care is secured.

patientEducation.summary: Acute immune-mediated polyradiculoneuropathy causing rapidly progressive weakness and reduced/absent reflexes, often after infection.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
